question: calculate 2023 rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: SELECT (SELECT (CAST(anc4_completed AS REAL) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)) * 100 FROM anc_visits WHERE district = 'Gaya' AND year = 2023) - (SELECT (CAST(anc4_completed AS REAL) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)) * 100 FROM anc_visits WHERE district = 'Gaya' AND year = 2021) AS gaya_rate_change, (SELECT (CAST(anc4_completed AS REAL) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)) * 100 FROM anc_visits WHERE district = 'Nalanda' AND year = 2023) - (SELECT (CAST(anc4_completed AS REAL) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)) * 100 FROM anc_visits WHERE district = 'Nalanda' AND year = 2021) AS nalanda_rate_change
